text.description_html:
PDQ Series 6202CV Concealed Vertical Rod Panic Device

The Narrow Stile Concealed Vertical Panic Device is used in commercial and residential settings such as hotels, condominiums, apartment buildings, and government buildings. The PDQ Series 6202CV Concealed Vertical Rod Panic Device devices blend the utility of a vertical rod application with the appearance of a traditional panic device. The rods are installed inside the door.

Features and Specifications of the Concealed Vertical Rod Panic Bar:

  • Top Latch: Pullman with dead latching 5/8” throw
  • Bottom Latch: Pullman with 5/8” throw, held retracted during door swing
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Minimum Stile Width: 2-5/8"
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Width: 36"
  • Mounting Height: 40" from floor to center line of the bottom latch case mounting stud
  • Fasteners: Furnished with sex nuts, machine screws, and wood screws
  • Dogging:Hex Key Dogging
  • ANSI Grade 1
  • Warranty: 10 Years

    • Special Ordered Item. No Returns
